channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Five simple ways to ease desk-related aches and pains
item.description: Prolonged desk sitting causes discomfort and health issues. Strategies to improve comfort include eye muscle exercises to reduce strain.

item.title: Trump's redistricting gives Republicans an edge, now voters decide
item.description: President Trump's push to reshape voting maps triggered rare mid-decade redistricting, giving Republicans an advantage in retaining the House.

item.title: GOP congressman voted to cut Medicaid, which covers 62% of his district
item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is seeking reelection in central California, where six in ten residents are covered by Medicaid.

item.title: Saving for a starter home now takes twice as long as in 2019
item.description: A new analysis finds the average renter household needs 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs, as rents and other expenses rise.
